Describe the shaded region shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
\{(x,y)\in {{field-1}}\,:\,{{field-2}}\le x\le {{field-3}},\,{{field-4}}\le y\le {{field-5}}\}
$$

A point $P(x,y)$ lies inside or on the rectangle's edges if the following conditions are satisfied:

$$
\begin{aligned}1\le x\le 6,\,3\le y\le 5\end{aligned}
$$

Moreover, since *every* real value in these intervals is included, $x\in R,y\in R,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in R\times R={R}^{2}.
$$

Therefore, we can write our set as follows:

$$
\{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,1\le x\le 6,\,3\le y\le 5\}
$$
